title: Garden and Choir
author: Mirabel Joubert
blurb: Vesper Winterbourne, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
